headline: Sensex surges over 1,900 points as foreign inflows and banking stocks fuel strong rally

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Strong foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices boosted market sentiment.
Rally driven by reverse AI trade pushing benchmark indices higher at the open.
Heavy buying in private banking and FMCG sectors led by top index heavyweights.
Oil prices steadied ahead of the upcoming Reserve Bank of India (RBI) rate decision.
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 1,900 points intraday, while Nifty crossed 25,900 to approach 25,950.
Nifty Financial Services index advanced 2% during early trading hours.
L&T Finance shares jumped over 6% on the back of strong trading volumes.
ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank emerged as key stock gainers leading the market rally.
summary:
Indian equities witnessed a massive rally on November 25, with the Sensex surging nearly 2,000 points intraday.
The market surge was backed by foreign fund inflows, cooling crude oil prices, and strong gains in private banking stocks.
Nifty topped 25,900 while financial services and banking heavyweights ICICI Bank and HDFC Bank led the market gains.
